dialogues.speaker: Tres
dialogues.text: Greetings, Honorary Knight. Are you ready to begin "Surveying and Searching"?

choices.text: Sure, I was just about to give it a try.

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: Okay, everything's ready. If you have any questions, feel free to ask.

choices.text: No, I just want to chat for a while.

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: Oh, okay... Wait, so... Am I supposed to come up with a topic? Ahem. Well, let's start with me, then.

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: I serve in the Ranged Company and am often assigned to work under Vice Captain Lohen. My duty is to scout ahead of the main unit and its flanks to gather initial intel on enemy movements...

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: In short, I scout the terrain ahead, mark dangerous areas and approximate enemy positions on the map, and then report back to the others.

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: Previously, Amber and Mika handled these tasks. But they can't be in two places at once, nor can they attend to all the companies at the same time.

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: Vice Captain Lohen recommended that I learn cartography techniques with Instructor Mika to make my surveys and markings as accurate as possible...

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: To better put myself in the shoes of others and understand how ordinary people interpret maps, Instructor Mika brought me along to draw up this "Surveying and Searching" challenge.

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: I can also gain some experience by observing how you solve the puzzles. That way, combined with what Instructor Mika has taught me, I'll be able to train more surveyors for the Company!

choices.text: I'd like to know how you're getting along with everyone.

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: How I'm getting along with the others? Well, everyone is really nice here... At least, the people I've met are great comrades. They are all very capable and responsible.

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: If I had to point to someone in particular... Vice Captain Lohen would be the one I admire most.

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: I often struggle to follow his train of thought, but he's incredibly reliable. Somehow, he always turns up in the most dangerous places on the map, and then he'll clear out the hidden perils without breaking a sweat.

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: Oh, and Eija Gretel, too. She's a signals officer from the 7th Company who works with a trained falcon!

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: The falcon may look a bit intimidating, but Eija is a reliable and easy-going person. I've heard that she often accompanies Amber to the Reconnaissance Company's camp...

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: Oh, she's pretty close to Elowen, and she raved about how good Elowen's cooking is. It made me want to try some for myself.

choices.text: I have nothing to ask right now.

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: Okay. If you'd like to try it out, just let me know. I'm always here.
